articles.title: More Xbox Layoffs Hit as Massive Reorg Continues; Activision to Make Next ‘Halo’ Game - The Hollywood Reporter
articles.description: The Microsoft-owned gamemaker is in the process of eliminating 3,200 jobs.

articles.title: Micron reportedly ends production of 2GB GDDR7 used by GeForce RTX 50 - VideoCardz.com
articles.description: Micron appears to be moving away from 2GB GDDR7 as its catalog shifts toward 3GB devices. The older 16Gb parts were already used on RTX 50 cards.

articles.title: Hellblade developer Ninja Theory to be shut down in new wave of Xbox cuts, as two separate agreements collapse - Eurogamer.net
articles.description: Ninja Theory - developer of the Hellblade series - is shutting down as part of today's Xbox cuts. Its proposed buyers pulled out, resulting in the closure.

articles.title: Apple Wallet driver’s licenses coming to three new states soon - 9to5Mac
articles.description: Apple Wallet driver’s licenses recently launched in Virginia and Oklahoma, but three more states are expected to follow soon.

articles.description: The RPG powerhouse has been rehoused

articles.title: Xbox is merging its Forza developers into a single studio - The Verge
articles.description: Playground Games and Turn 10 Studios staff will now focus on Forza Horizon and Fable together.
